newsitem.title: USA: Point of Care names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Point of Care names new chairman.

text.p: Point of Care Technologies Inc on Thursday said its founder, chief scientific officer and chairman, Raouf Guirguis, was resigning.
Michael Pratt, president and chief executive, was named to succeed Guirguis as chairman. Pratt will retain his current titles.
The company said he was resigning to "devote his full time and efforts to other scientific and business pursuits."
Point of Care is a healthcare company involved in disposable screening and diagnostic-testing products for home-based and point-of-care applications.
